def countSubstrings(s):
    def expand_around_center(left, right):
        L, R = left, right
        while L >= 0 and R < len(s) and s[L] == s[R]:
            L -= 1
            R += 1
        return R - L - 1

    count = 0
    for i in range(len(s)):
        count += expand_around_center(i, i)
        count += expand_around_center(i, i + 1)
    return count
